summary.goal: When an agent completes a task, prompt it for a retrospective reflection that captures summary, approach, decisions, challenges, learnings, and confidence. This structured reflection becomes part of the trajectory.

acceptance_criteria.description: Forgemaster injects retrospective prompt after agent signals completion via report_complete
Retrospective captures: summary, approach, decisions[], challenges[], learnings[], suggestions[], confidence
Agent response parsed and stored in trajectory as 'retrospective_recorded' event
Decision entries in retrospective linked to inline record_decision tool calls
Retrospective viewable in timeline and trajectory export
Confidence score (0-1) informs future task assignment

observations: Retrospective happens before agent exit, while context is fresh
Structured format enables querying across retrospectives
Confidence score is self-reported but useful for patterns
Uses relay message to inject prompt into running agent
patterns: Post-task reflection prompt injection via relay

architect.retrospective_format: { summary: string, approach: string, decisions: [{ question, chosen, reasoning }], challenges: string[], learnings: string[], suggestions: string[], confidence: number (0-1) }
architect.trigger: After agent calls report_complete, before release

steps.title: Define retrospective schema
steps.description: Define Zod schema for retrospective data

acceptance_criteria.description: RetrospectiveSchema: { summary, approach, decisions: [{ question, chosen, reasoning }], challenges[], learnings[], suggestions[], confidence: number }
confidence is 0-1 range
Export type from schema

steps.title: Create retrospective prompt template
steps.description: Template for prompting agent to provide retrospective

acceptance_criteria.description: Prompt asks agent to reflect on completed task
Prompt specifies JSON output format matching RetrospectiveSchema
Template is configurable per project

architecture.template_example: Now that you've completed the task, please provide a brief retrospective in the following JSON format: { summary: '...', approach: '...', decisions: [...], challenges: [...], learnings: [...], suggestions: [...], confidence: 0.0-1.0 }

steps.title: Implement retrospective injection after completion with timeout handling
steps.description: Send retrospective prompt to agent after report_complete with explicit timeout behavior

acceptance_criteria.description: Listen for report_complete MCP tool call
Before marking agent for release, send retrospective prompt via relay message
Wait for agent response (timeout: 30 seconds)
On timeout: store trajectory event 'retrospective_timeout' with reason, task still completes successfully
retrospective_timeout event includes: task_id, timeout_duration, agent_last_message

architecture.integration: Hook in report_complete handler in forge-mcp-tools
architecture.timeout_handling: Store explicit 'retrospective_timeout' event - don't silently skip

steps.title: Parse and store retrospective with explicit malformed handling
steps.description: Parse agent's retrospective response with clear handling of malformed responses

acceptance_criteria.description: Parse JSON from agent response
Validate against RetrospectiveSchema
Valid: store as trajectory event type='retrospective_recorded'
Invalid JSON: store trajectory event 'retrospective_parse_error' with raw_response and parse_error fields
Invalid schema: store trajectory event 'retrospective_validation_error' with raw_response and validation_errors fields
All error events visible in timeline and trajectory export

architecture.pattern: JSON parsing with explicit error events - never silently skip or log-and-forget
architecture.error_visibility: All parsing/validation errors stored as trajectory events, visible in UI timeline

steps.title: Link decisions to record_decision calls
steps.description: Cross-reference retrospective decisions with earlier record_decision tool calls

acceptance_criteria.description: Query trajectory for decision_recorded events for this task
Match retrospective decisions by question similarity
Add event_id references to linked decisions

steps.title: Add retrospective to trajectory query API
steps.description: Include retrospective in trajectory timeline and export

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /runs/:id/trajectory includes retrospective_recorded, retrospective_timeout, and retrospective_*_error events
GET /runs/:id/tasks/:taskId includes retrospective if available, or error_type if failed
Export includes formatted retrospective or error details
